<div class="card-body">
'''URoRRuR'R'R''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。他のタスケン・レイダーと同じ位置にいるなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRR-PSA-93071765.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダー部族のリーダー。機械を恐れない。優れた狩人にして銃の名手。水を奪いにモイスチャー・ファームを襲撃する。不用心な旅行者を求めてジャンドランドの荒地を徘徊する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' URoRRuR'R'R.

'''Card text:'''
May deploy only on Tatooine, but from there may move anywhere. If at the same location as another Tusken Raider, may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to.

'''Lore:'''
Leader of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. A skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes seeking unwary travelers.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face adds that after deploying on Tatooine he may move anywhere.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[URoRRuR'R'R]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
